notes.title: Update Notes for Jan 18th
notes.notes:
Birth of Shadows has been updated to version 1.9.11.1 on January 18th, 2025 with the following changes:

 Improved experience when playing in a window, so that the dimensions always fit within the desktop space.
 The F11 key will now toggle between full-screen and window modes.
 Updated development toolset and support libraries (target Windows 10).

notes.title: Update notes for June 26, 2024
notes.notes:
Version 1.9.11.0 released on June 26, 2024.


 Updated renderer from DirectX 8 to DirectX 9
 Improved terrain blending
 Increased the size of trees that are alive
 Game will now fade multiple entities around target to help with visibility with larger trees

notes.title: Update Notes for June 24, 2021.
notes.notes:
Version 1.9.10.8 was released on June 24, 2021.

This update focuses on improving the experience during combat as well as the camera tracking while moving around the world. It includes the following changes:


 All new artwork for combat projectiles.
 Many enhancements to the particle effects implementation.
 Camera tracking for player movement should be smoother.
 Camera tracking is now disabled while agro'd to make it easier to move around during combat.
 Moving will automatically stop when player first gains agro and nearest enemy will be selected if visible.
 Added a graphic for selected destination when moving (green for reachable and red for unreachable).
 Enemies will now show a red selection box when attackable (in range and line-of-sight).
 Bosses will do the same, but only when vulnerable to damage (purple to help standout).
 Selected enemy will fade-out the graphic when not attackable.
 Fixed a potential crash in multi-threaded path-finding implementation.
 Many other fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: Updated to version 1.9.10.6
notes.notes:
Birth of Shadows was updated to 1.9.10.6 on March 31, 2017.

The update includes higher-quality versions of all music tracks. The game will now stream music tracks in the background, using much less memory.

In addition, scrolling will now start slower and then smoothly accelerate. That should make it easier to move around during combat.

notes.title: Updated to version 1.9.10.5
notes.notes:
Birth of Shadows was updated to version 1.9.10.5 on December 1st, 2015. This update implemented cycling enemy targets using the TAB key. The nearest enemies will be selected before targets further away. Bosses will not be selected until they are vulnerable to avoid accidental damage. TAB cycling should make it easier to use abilities with the mouse. It will also make it possible to use devices like the Steam controller.

In addition, there was an update for version 1.9.10.4 on November 22nd with the following new features:

    Steam players hosting a multiplayer game can now invite a friend to the game
    Steam players can now join a multiplayer game hosted by a friend

Check the post on Multiplayer Setup for more details.
